ruleName: Ball in motion accidentally hits ... the flagstick
title: Your ball hits the flagstick in the hole
question: On the putting green, if your ball accidentally hits the flagstick that is left in the hole, what should you do?

choices.text: Replay the shot from the same spot.
Add a penalty stroke and play the ball from where it stops.
Play the ball as it lies, no penalty.
Remove the flagstick and replace your ball before playing on.

explanation: There is no penalty if your ball hits the flagstick left in the hole. You simply play the ball from where it comes to rest.
imagePrompt: A teenage girl golfer on the putting green has just putted and her ball has struck the flagstick left in the hole. She prepares to play the next putt.
imageAlt: Teen girl golfer's ball hits flagstick in the hole on green.

issues: The club, golfer posture, green, ball, and hole are all realistic and match the left-handed spec.
Ball is positioned perfectly near the flagstick, clearly showing the intended scene.
All visual details (blue top, red shorts, cap, medium mixed skin tone) are accurate.

The only very minor issue is that the ball could show a slightly more dramatic 'just struck' position (e.g., a hint of motion or proximity to the flag), but this does not break the educational intent.
imageVerification.repairPrompt: Slightly emphasize that the golf ball has just impacted the flagstick by showing a subtle motion effect, vibration of the flagstick, or the ball closer to or gently rebounding from the stick, while maintaining all current proportions, realism, and scene details.
